title: AI Guard with NVIDIA NeMo Guardrails: the ready-to-use custom action and rails, the proposed library plugin, and the defects in both as shipped

prose.text: The NeMo folder holds a configuration to copy into a NeMo Guardrails project and a library-format plugin written for submission to the NeMo Guardrails repository. {{two-forms}}

prose.label: The custom action.
prose.text: {{config-rails}} {{config-endpoint}} {{config-verdict}} {{action-name-mismatch}} Whether NeMo still finds the action is open {{gap:action-name-resolution}}.

checks.do: With the custom config, that the action name in rails.co matches the name registered in actions/zs-ai-guard.py, and that a test prompt actually produces an AI Guard transaction.
Do not deploy the library plugin as shipped: its SDK import fails, so every turn is blocked.

two-forms.statement: `config/` is a standalone NeMo Guardrails configuration (a custom action plus Colang input and output rails), and `library-plugin/` is a library-format plugin (`zscaler_aiguard`) with a system action and Colang 2.0 and Colang 1.0 flows, meant to be submitted to NeMo Guardrails.

quotes: A library-format plugin (`zscaler_aiguard/`) ready to submit as a PR to [NVIDIA-NeMo/Guardrails](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Guardrails).
| `rails/rails.co` | Colang flow definitions for input/output scanning |

config-rails.statement: The custom rails scan `$user_message` as the prompt (direction IN) on input and `$bot_message` as the response (direction OUT) on output, and on a block make the bot refuse to respond and stop.

quotes:
if $result[blocked]
    bot refuse to respond
    stop

config-endpoint.statement: The custom action calls `resolve_and_execute_policy` through the SDK's `LegacyZGuardClientHelper` unless `AIGUARD_POLICY_ID` holds an integer, in which case it calls `execute_policy` with it; a non-integer value is logged as a warning and ignored. No transaction ID is sent.

quotes: log.warning("AIGUARD_POLICY_ID=%r is not a valid integer, ignoring", _env_policy_id)

config-verdict.statement: The custom action starts from a blocked verdict and clears it only when the action is ALLOW or DETECT, so an SDK error, an exception, a None result or a missing action all leave the turn blocked.

quotes: log.error("AI Guard scan failed: %s - %s", type(e).__name__, str(e))

if error:
        raise Exception(f"AI Guard API error: {error}")

evidence.after: log.error("AI Guard scan failed: %s - %s", type(e).__name__, str(e))

action-name-mismatch.statement: The custom action is registered as `CallZsAiGuardAction`, while `config.yml` and `rails.co` refer to `CallZscalerAiGuardAction`.

library-import.statement: The library plugin imports `LegacyZGuardClientHelper` from `zscaler.zaiguard.legacy`, the module path the repository's 0.2.0 changelog says was wrong and fixed to `zscaler.aiguard.legacy` for NeMo Guardrails among others; the import is lazy, inside `_get_sdk_client`, which `_scan_sync` calls from within the action's try block.

quotes:
except Exception as e:
        log.error("AI Guard scan failed: %s — %s", type(e).__name__, e)
Fixed `ModuleNotFoundError: zscaler.zaiguard` in LiteLLM, NeMo Guardrails, Portkey and TrueFoundry — the module is `zscaler.aiguard.legacy`

library-always-blocks.statement: As shipped, every library-plugin scan fails on the import and the action returns BLOCK, so the flows refuse every user prompt and bot message.
library-always-blocks.conditions: The SDK at its registered pin has no zscaler/zaiguard package (directory listing of vendor/zscaler-sdk-python/zscaler), so the import raises ImportError, which the action's broad except turns into BLOCK. Not executed.

library-flows.statement: The library action returns the verdict's action upper-cased (ALLOW without a scan for empty text, BLOCK on an exception or a None result), and both flow files act only when `$result.action == "BLOCK"`; the action's output mapping, which treats anything but ALLOW or DETECT as a block, is not what the flows test.

quotes: log.warning("AI Guard returned None — blocking by default")

Returns True (block) for anything that is not an explicit ALLOW or the
    monitor-only DETECT

evidence.after: flow zscaler aiguard moderation on input
define subflow zscaler aiguard moderation on input

library-no-verdict.statement: Once the import is corrected, a verdict-less reply (an HTTP 200 without `action`, such as "Policy not found") becomes the action string `NONE`, which the flows do not treat as a block, so the turn proceeds.

quotes: self.action = config["action"] if "action" in config else None

library-no-verdict.conditions: Follows from the SDK model setting action to None when the reply has none and from Python's str(None).upper() being "NONE"; whether NeMo applies the output mapping anywhere the flows would see it is not established.

versions.statement: The README requires NeMo Guardrails 0.18.0 or later and installs `zscaler-sdk-python` without a version constraint.

sdk-unpinned.statement: Nothing in the folder pins `zscaler-sdk-python`, so the SDK version is whatever the README's unconstrained install resolves.
sdk-unpinned.conditions: Rests on a file listing of NemoGuardrails/ at the pin (LICENSE.md, README.md, SUPPORT.md, config/config.yml, config/actions, config/rails, library-plugin/README.md and the zscaler_aiguard package), which has no requirements.txt, pyproject.toml or setup file; an absence from a listing, not a quoted line.

action-name-resolution.title: Whether NeMo Guardrails resolves CallZscalerAiGuardAction to the action registered as CallZsAiGuardAction
action-name-resolution.detail: The shipped rails execute CallZscalerAiGuardAction but the custom action registers CallZsAiGuardAction. If NeMo cannot resolve the name, the rails never reach AI Guard; what NeMo then does (an error, or a rail that passes) depends on NeMo's action dispatcher, which is not a registered source.
action-name-resolution.blocks: whether the NeMo custom configuration scans anything as shipped

library-fail-closed.summary: Whether the NeMo library plugin fails closed on a reply without a verdict.

positions.says: The NeMo README says the integration is fail-closed: content is blocked if the API call fails or returns an unexpected response.

quotes: - **Fail-closed**: If the API call fails or returns an unexpected response, content is blocked by default.

positions.says: The library flows block only when the returned action equals BLOCK.

evidence.after: flow zscaler aiguard moderation on output

library-fail-closed.impact: The custom-config action does fail closed (config-verdict); the library plugin, once its import is fixed, would pass verdict-less replies (library-no-verdict).
